parties: Ceylon News Papers (Private) Limited v. V.P.K. Weerasinghe, Commissioner General of Labour & Others Ceylon News Papers (Private) Limited v. V.P.K. Weerasinghe, Commissioner General of Labour & Others View More
keywords: Labour law – Termination of employment – Commissioner of Labour – Preliminary objections to jurisdiction – Employer alleging disciplinary termination – No termination letter and only disputed purported confession – Issue properly left for substantive inquiry – Employee employed approximately nine months – Meaning of 180 days within a continuous period of twelve months – Act does not require completion of a full year of service – Employee had more than 180 days’ service – Commissioner possessed jurisdiction – Certiorari refused – Application dismissed without costs. Vijith K. Malalgoda PC J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act No. 45 of 1971, as amended – sections 2(4), 3(1)(a) and 3(1)(b); Workmen’s Compensation Ordinance – Schedule III, as incorporated in the statutory wording considered.
